# Keep saved entries safe after an invalid edit attempt

## What & Why
Editing coverage confirms that blank edits do not overwrite saved data, but it does not assert the field-specific recovery guidance shown during that failed edit. A focused browser regression should protect both the user’s saved entry and the accessible correction path.

## Done looks like
- Clearing each required field on an existing answer or opportunity shows the correct visible message
- The invalid field exposes aria-invalid and aria-describedby while the dialog stays open
- The previously saved value remains unchanged until the edit is corrected or cancelled
